paragraphs.text: A rain garden is a shallow hollow planted with grasses that takes water from a roof or a road. The water soaks away within a day, so mosquitoes cannot breed. Such gardens cost less than new drains.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One city planted 300 of them along a single avenue. After two years, flooding of cellars during storms had stopped, although the city still needs its main sewer for very heavy rain.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: The water soaks away within a day
items.prompt: Rain gardens hold water for several days.

explanation.en: The water soaks away within a day → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Су бір тәулік ішінде сіңеді → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Вода уходит в течение суток → FALSE.

items.quote: Such gardens cost less than new drains
items.prompt: Rain gardens are cheaper than building new drains.

explanation.kk: «cost less than new drains» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.
explanation.ru: «cost less than new drains» → TRUE. Мәтінде нақты айтылған.

items.quote: the city still needs its main sewer for very heavy rain
items.prompt: The city has closed its main sewer.

explanation.en: The city still needs the sewer → FALSE.
explanation.kk: Қалаға басты құбыр әлі де қажет → FALSE.
explanation.ru: Город по-прежнему нуждается в коллекторе → FALSE.

items.quote: One city planted 300 of them along a single avenue
items.prompt: Residents paid for the gardens themselves.

explanation.en: Who paid is not stated → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.kk: Кім төлегені мәтінде айтылмаған → NOT GIVEN.
explanation.ru: Кто платил, в тексте не сказано → NOT GIVEN.
